import.filesTitle: Open one or more files: FITS, XISF, TIFF, PNG or camera RAW
import.folderTitle: Import all the FITS, XISF and RAW files in a folder
import.telescopeTitleUnset: Import frames from the telescope folder: set it first in Settings, Telescope tab
import.telescopeTitle: Choose the frames to import from the telescope folder ({folder})

reset.label: Reset
reset.title: Return the image to how it was when opened, undoing the adjustments (R key)

rotateCounterclockwise: Rotate the image 90° counterclockwise. The rotation also applies to the export; to remove it, use Undo.
rotateClockwise: Rotate the image 90° clockwise. The rotation also applies to the export; to remove it, use Undo.
mirrorHorizontal: Mirror the image left to right, losslessly. The mirroring also applies to the export; to remove it, use Undo.
mirrorVertical: Mirror the image top to bottom, losslessly. The mirroring also applies to the export; to remove it, use Undo.
straighten: Straighten: rotate the image by any angle, draw a line to straighten or bring north to the top

fit.label: Fit
fit.title: Fit the image to the window (0 key)

crop.label: Crop
crop.hideTitle: Hide the crop box in the viewer; the export still uses it ({key} key)
crop.showTitle: Show the export crop in the viewer: drag the box to move it, pull the corners and sides to resize it ({key} key)

magicWand.label: Abracadabra
magicWand.title: Prepare the image automatically by measuring it and correcting sky background, color, noise, detail, stars and tones. The chosen values remain editable in the Process and Correct steps, and the Reset button returns the image to the original.

strength.title: Abracadabra strength: {level}
strength.note: Applies to the button and to batch processing. Defects, sky background and color are always corrected the same way; it changes how much it acts on grain, sharpness, stars, local contrast and saturation.
strength.gentleHint: For data that is already clean or images that only need a finishing touch: half the measured dose.
strength.balancedHint: The dose measured on the image. This is the recommended choice.
strength.strongHint: For short, very grainy sessions: a stronger dose, with more risk of halos and a plastic look.
